subject: Webhook signature verification always fails
description: I'm computing HMAC-SHA256 of the JSON body using our signing secret but it never matches the Cobalt-Signature header. I'm parsing the JSON, re-serializing it, and hashing that.
resolution_notes: Customer was hashing the re-serialized JSON instead of the raw request body, which changes key ordering. Told them to hash the raw bytes before any parsing. Confirmed working after the fix.

subject: Getting 429 errors on our Pro plan integration
description: We're seeing 429 Too Many Requests during peak hours. We're on the Pro plan. What's the actual limit and how do we avoid this?
resolution_notes: Pro plan is 120 requests/minute. Advised switching their polling-based Google Sheets trigger to a webhook-based trigger where possible, since polling counts against the per-minute limit on every check.

subject: Slack action failing with channel_not_found
description: Our Send Message action to #signups keeps failing. The channel definitely exists.
resolution_notes: The Cobalt Loop bot user was never invited to the #signups channel. Had them run /invite @Cobalt Loop in Slack. Resolved.

subject: API key stopped working right after rotation
description: Rotated our key 30 seconds ago and now getting 401 AUTH_KEY_REVOKED on the new key, not the old one.
resolution_notes: Customer had a typo copying the new key (trailing space). Not a propagation delay issue as initially suspected. Re-copied key, resolved.

subject: Locked out of account after enabling SSO enforcement
description: We enabled 'Require SSO for all members' this morning and now half our team can't log in at all.
resolution_notes: The locked-out members were never assigned to the Cobalt Loop app in the customer's Okta instance. Walked them through assigning all team members in Okta first, then re-verified login. Recommended they always verify IdP assignment before enforcing SSO going forward.

subject: Workflow shows Active but hasn't fired in 3 days despite new rows
description: New rows are definitely being added to the sheet but the workflow run history is empty.

subject: Duplicate Slack messages for the same signup event
description: Every new signup sends two identical Slack messages instead of one.
resolution_notes: Found two active workflows with an identical trigger configuration — a teammate had duplicated the workflow while testing and forgot to deactivate the copy. Paused the duplicate. Suggested enabling Duplicate Detection under workflow settings.

subject: Can we get retroactive processing for rows added before the workflow was turned on?
description: We had 200 existing rows in the sheet before activating the workflow and none of them triggered anything. Can this be backfilled?
resolution_notes: Explained this is expected behavior — triggers only fire for data created after activation, historical data isn't retroactively processed. No backfill feature currently exists. Customer acknowledged and closed the ticket.

subject: GitHub PR merged trigger fired for a PR that was only closed
description: We closed PR #482 without merging, but our workflow ran as if it had been merged.

subject: Question about downgrade timing
description: If we downgrade from Business to Pro today, do we lose access immediately or at the end of the billing period?
resolution_notes: Confirmed downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing period, current plan limits remain active until then. Customer proceeded with the downgrade.

subject: Field mapping shows blank output but no error anywhere
description: Our Slack message action sends but the message body is completely empty. No errors in run history.
resolution_notes: Customer had a typo in the field reference ({{trigger.emial}} instead of {{trigger.email}}). Unresolved field references silently resolve to empty string rather than erroring, which is why nothing showed as failed. Corrected the typo.

subject: SAML assertion signature invalid during test login
description: Testing our new Okta SSO connection and getting 'assertion signature invalid' every time.
resolution_notes: Customer had uploaded an older cached copy of the IdP metadata XML. Had them re-download current metadata directly from Okta and re-upload. Test login succeeded after.

subject: GitHub trigger not showing repository we granted access to
description: We approved access to 3 repos in the GitHub App install but only 2 show up as available triggers in Cobalt Loop.
resolution_notes: Repository access at the GitHub App level doesn't auto-sync to Cobalt Loop's workflow list until manually refreshed. Had them click Refresh Repository List under Connected Apps. Third repo appeared.

subject: Webhook marked Failed after exactly 4 retries, is that expected?
description: Our endpoint was down for about 2 hours during a deploy and one webhook delivery shows Failed. Is there a way to get it retried again?
resolution_notes: Confirmed 4 retries over roughly 1.5 hours is expected before marking Failed. Customer can manually replay failed deliveries from Run History within 7 days — walked them through doing that for the affected delivery.

subject: Monthly task limit exceeded — will our workflows stop running?
description: We just got the 100% usage warning email. Are our workflows going to stop working?
resolution_notes: Clarified that exceeding the monthly limit does not pause workflows automatically on their Business plan (no overage billing configured). Recommended upgrading before next cycle if usage trend continues, since a future overage billing policy change was mentioned as a possibility to watch for in their contract renewal.

subject: Need SCIM and manual member management to coexist temporarily
description: We're migrating to SCIM but want to keep a couple of manually-added contractor accounts that aren't in our IdP group yet.

subject: Export of run history for compliance before account deletion
description: We're closing this account for compliance reasons but need last month's run history exported first.
resolution_notes: Provided the export endpoint (GET /workflows/{id}/runs?format=export) and confirmed exports don't count against rate limits. Customer exported successfully before proceeding with account deletion.

subject: Full webhook payload missing from run history detail view
description: We only see a truncated version of the action response in run history, not the full payload we need for debugging.
resolution_notes: Explained that only a 10KB preview is retained by default, and Full Payload Logging is opt-in due to PII retention concerns. Customer enabled it under Workflow settings after confirming their data doesn't include sensitive customer PII.
